Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: bigger map sizes
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Adds 350, 400, 450 and 500 to the map sizes you can pick when starting a game. Big maps are slow on weak computers.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: strip before cremating
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Cremating a corpse first drops its clothes and weapons next to the crematorium, so nothing useful burns with it.
